messages:
elena: quick follow-up from today's all-hands runtime Q&A. dropping a short digest + concrete asks so things don't fall through the cracks.

samir: thanks! can you confirm the three top perf threads we agreed on? batching, kv-cache, kernel selection?

ja: yes + int8 op-fusion. prioritize batching heuristics (adaptive window), TTL/eviction policy for prefix cache, and a rules-first kernel selector with telemetry hooks.

matt: on canaries: what's the gating matrix? p99 latency, p95 error-rate, and a small eval pass?

elena: gate = p99 latency (+ tail ratio p99/p50), error-rate spike >1.5x baseline, and smoke eval on core prompt set. token-cost check is advisory for now.

samir: caching defaults? hoping we can tighten for personalization routes to avoid memory blowups.

ja: default prefix TTL 2m, session embeddings 24h. personalization routes: opt-in short TTL (15s) + per-worker max-entries. ticketed.

ana: ops ask: canary must run across hosted + at least one dedicated cluster and two driver versions.

ci-bot: canary-start: runtime-vnext on hosted-us-east + dedicated-eu-west at 1920034630. monitors: latency, errors, mem, eval-diffs.

matt: please add a quantization badge in console when requests served in int8 > 10% and emit sample diffs for product review (anonymized).

ja: will add telemetry + KERN ticket for anonymized sampling and PII scrubber.

elena: owners & quick actions: - Samir: draft per-route max-window config + sample (owner: samir, due: 3d) - Jia: prefix eviction + int8 fusion tickets + perf targets (owner: jia, due: next sprint) - Ana/Ops: ensure canary matrix includes dedicated + multi-driver (owner: ana, due: today) - Matt: quality-gating checklist + sample-review plan (owner: matt, due: 48h)

elena: i'll paste this into the runtime roadmap doc and ping owners. reply here if you need to adjust timelines. :white_check_mark:
